resolved_conflicts.explanation: WillhiteWeb visited in 2019 and could not confirm the exact spot; its AWS documents place a station in a neighboring section. The record keeps the FFLOS coordinates from firetower.org.

notes_for_editor: Brief access 'unknown' set to permission from WillhiteWeb's permit note. The Weebly page lists an Air Warning Service station, 'How 1-3', under its Burt entry on private land; it may not be this lookout, so the story does not tie it to the site. The 12-foot figure is as the sources give it; they do not say whether it is tower height or cab size, so no height_m is set. The 1937 and 1953 dates repeat across compilations and may trace to one older list.
